GAB300T.productiondescription: Gabby Kid's 30-inch Round Table by Steve Silver. Sized just right for little ones, the Gabby Kids Round Table brings laid-back California style to playrooms, kitchens, or craft corners. At 23 inches high with a spacious 30-inch top, it’s perfect for snacks, puzzles, and playdates. Made from oak veneers and Asian hardwoods, Gabby features rounded edges, sturdy tubular legs, and a washed oak finish that highlights the wood’s natural charm. Stylish, safe, and built to last—Gabby is a table they’ll grow with and love every day. Features: Expertly crafted for kids using the same high-quality materials as the full-size Gabby Dining Table—Asian, hardwood solids, oak veneers, and engineered woods—for a sturdy and stylish piece scaled perfectly for little ones.; Kiln-dried wood construction helps resist warping, splitting, and mildew, ensuring long-lasting performance through both mealtime messes and playtime adventures.; Solid wood legs provide dependable stability and support, built to withstand everyday use with the same timeless craftsmanship as the adult version.; Mortise-and-tenon joinery with reinforced corner blocks ensures superior strength and structural integrity, making it a durable choice for active young users.; Wire-brushed and rub-through finish adds texture and charm, giving the table a unique, rustic character that complements any playroom or dining space.; Plastic floor glides on the legs help prevent scratches and scuffs, keeping floors looking their best even during energetic play.; Hand-applied washed oak finish showcases the natural beauty of the wood grain and knots, bringing warmth and organic elegance to a kid-friendly size.; Perfectly proportioned for children , this table comfortably seats up to six kids, making it ideal for shared meals, crafts, and group play.
GAB300T.techspecs:
• Expertly crafted for kids using the same high-quality materials as the full-size Gabby Dining Table—Asian, hardwood solids, oak veneers, and engineered woods—for a sturdy and stylish piece scaled perfectly for little ones.
• Kiln-dried wood construction helps resist warping, splitting, and mildew, ensuring long-lasting performance through both mealtime messes and playtime adventures.
• Solid wood legs provide dependable stability and support, built to withstand everyday use with the same timeless craftsmanship as the adult version.
• Mortise-and-tenon joinery with reinforced corner blocks ensures superior strength and structural integrity, making it a durable choice for active young users.
• Wire-brushed and rub-through finish adds texture and charm, giving the table a unique, rustic character that complements any playroom or dining space.
• Plastic floor glides on the legs help prevent scratches and scuffs, keeping floors looking their best even during energetic play.
